places.name: Bom Jesus do Monte Sanctuary (UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, Bom Jesus do Monte Sanctuary is renowned for its baroque stairway and panoramic views of Braga.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round.

places.place_tip: Climb the stairway for the best experience and views.
places.address: Estrada do Bom Jesus, 4715-056 Braga, Portugal

attribution.author: Botafogo

places.name: Braga Cathedral
places.ai_summary: The Braga Cathedral, one of Portugal's oldest churches, showcases Romanesque, Gothic, and Baroque architectural styles.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the cathedral's museum for historical artifacts.
places.address: R. Dom Paio Mendes, 4700-424 Braga, Portugal

places.name: Arco da Porta Nova
places.ai_summary: Arco da Porta Nova is an iconic archway in Braga, representing the city's historical entrance and featuring intricate baroque designs.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for photography.

places.place_tip: Visit early morning or late afternoon for the best light for photos.
places.address: R. da Porta Nova, 4700-031 Braga, Portugal

places.name: Jardim de Santa Bárbara
places.ai_summary: A beautiful garden in the heart of Braga, Jardim de Santa Bárbara is known for its romantic ambiance, floral displays, and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round. Hours may vary in winter.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to relax in the garden's peaceful environment.
places.address: R. de São Paulo, 4700-424 Braga, Portugal

attribution.title: Santa Barbara Garden
attribution.author: José Goncalves
attribution.description: Santa Barbara Garden in Braga, Portugal.

places.name: Palácio do Raio
places.ai_summary: Palácio do Raio is a stunning example of baroque architecture in Braga, featuring a blue and white tile façade and ornate interior.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check out the interior tiles and the baroque chapel.

places.name: Sameiro Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: Sameiro Sanctuary is a prominent pilgrimage site in Braga, known for its impressive basilica and panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round. Check for mass times.

places.place_tip: Visit the basilica and enjoy the views from the terrace.

places.name: Braga Municipal Stadium
places.ai_summary: Home to S.C. Braga, the Braga Municipal Stadium is known for its modern architecture and impressive capacity.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary on match days.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for matches or events.
places.address: Estádio Municipal de Braga, 4700-223 Braga, Portugal

places.name: Museu dos Biscainhos
places.ai_summary: This museum, set in a former 17th-century convent, showcases Braga's history and religious art.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and major holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the baroque chapel and the gardens.

attribution.title: Casa e Museu dos Biscainhos (7)
attribution.author: Sara silva
attribution.description: O Museu dos Biscaínhos encontra-se instalado numa casa do século XVII (ampliada no século XVIII) com magníficos jardins de traçado barroco

places.name: Praça da República
places.ai_summary: The main square of Braga, Praça da República is surrounded by historical buildings and is a central spot for events and gatherings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Check out the nearby cafes and shops.

attribution.title: Braga, Avenida Central
attribution.author: K. Kendall from Portland, OR, USA

places.name: Avenida da Liberdade
places.ai_summary: A major avenue in Braga, Avenida da Liberdade is known for its shops, cafes, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee or meal at one of the terrace cafes.

places.name: Theatro Circo
places.ai_summary: Theatro Circo is a historic theater in Braga, known for its impressive architecture and diverse cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for event timings.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

attribution.title: Theatro Circo, fachada principal
attribution.author: Sara silva

places.name: Capela dos Coimbras
places.ai_summary: A small but historically significant chapel in Braga, Capela dos Coimbras is known for its simple architecture and serene location.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round.

places.place_tip: A peaceful spot for reflection and photography.

places.name: Fonte do Ídolo
places.ai_summary: An ancient Roman monument in Braga, Fonte do Ídolo is a must-visit for history enthusiasts, featuring intricate carvings and a serene setting.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk in the surrounding area.

places.name: Bom Jesus Funicular
places.ai_summary: The Bom Jesus Funicular is a historic funicular railway in Braga, offering a unique and scenic way to reach the Bom Jesus do Monte Sanctuary.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for maintenance closures.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the ride and the views over Braga.
places.address: Estrada do Bom Jesus, 4715-056 Braga, Portugal

attribution.title: Elevador Hidráulico (14740970272) (2)
attribution.author: Glória Moura Gonçalves from Luanda, Angola

places.name: Rua do Souto Shopping Street
places.ai_summary: A popular shopping street in Braga, Rua do Souto is lined with a variety of shops, cafes, and boutiques, perfect for a leisurely stroll.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for unique finds.

places.name: Igreja de São Marcos
places.ai_summary: Igreja de São Marcos is a historic church in Braga, known for its beautiful azulejos (ceramic tiles) and baroque altar.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round.

places.place_tip: Take time to admire the tile work and altar.
places.address: R. de São Marcos, 4700-223 Braga, Portugal

attribution.title: Cidade Maravilhosa
attribution.author: Rafael Rabello de Barros

places.name: Sete Fontes Aqueduct
places.ai_summary: An impressive aqueduct in Braga, Sete Fontes Aqueduct is known for its beautiful arches and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from a distance for photos.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby park for a complete experience.

attribution.title: Mãe d'Água Alvim de Baixo (2)
attribution.author: Joseolgon
attribution.description: Mãe d'Água Alvim de Baixo in Sete Fontes, Braga, Portugal.

places.name: Tibães Monastery
places.ai_summary: A beautiful monastery located a short drive from Braga, Tibães Monastery is known for its stunning architecture and peaceful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and major holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy the tranquility.

places.name: Braga Archaeological Museum
places.ai_summary: The Braga Archaeological Museum offers insights into the ancient history of the region, featuring artifacts from the Roman and medieval periods.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and major holidays.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed insights.

attribution.title: Geira Milha XXIX caminho
attribution.author: Júlio Reis
attribution.description: Milestone XXIX from the Via Romana XVIII, which connected Bracara Augusta to Asturica Augusta. Roadside with milestone.

places.name: Casa Rolão
places.ai_summary: A historic house museum in Braga, Casa Rolão showcases the traditional lifestyle and architecture of the region.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and major holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and the traditional kitchen.
places.address: R. de São Marcos, 4700-223 Braga, Portugal
